name: pr-description
description: Always-on pull request description posture for AI coding agents: fill a repo's PR template when present, otherwise write a title in Conventional Commits form and a body covering what, why, how it was verified, and risk, with tracking references in the footer and no AI attribution. Linking syntax is used only when the PR delivers the work item; citing one as provenance uses a sigil-free form, and every linking surface (commit, title, description, branch) is checked rather than just the description.

source.title: PR Description Convention
source.relationship: Authored as a portable baseline pack to sit alongside commit-conventions and git-collaboration-hygiene, governing the human-facing PR body rather than the commit message. Kept generic so it applies to work and personal repositories. 2026-09-01: ported explicit commit-attribution cross-references (Rule 3, Non-Goals) from the sibling es-ai-toolkit pack (was ahead here); its Rule 5 ADO-specific wording is a legitimate scope difference, not ported.
